chunks: Abān narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
Do not eat from vessels of gold or silver.

key_terms.آنِيَةِ: vessels or utensils used for food and drink
key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, the Imam transmitting the ruling
key_terms.تَأْكُلْ: eat; the act being prohibited in this narration
key_terms.ذَهَبٍ: gold, one of the prohibited materials mentioned for vessels
key_terms.فِضَّةٍ: silver, the other prohibited material mentioned for vessels

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about eating from gold and silver utensils?
ai.summary: This hadith transmits a legal prohibition from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام against eating from utensils made of gold or silver. It reflects Islamic etiquette and fiqh concerning lawful use of luxury vessels and sets a boundary on permissible dining practices.
